_comment: OptionsAgent config. Hard rails live in code (harness/risk_rails.py), NOT here, so they can't be loosened by editing JSON. This file holds tunables only.
_risk_comment: Operator 2026-07-03: no percentage caps. Position budget = conviction-scaled fraction of AVAILABLE options buying power (floor conviction -> 30%, max conviction -> 100%, may take everything). Kill knob: OA_MAX_POSITION_USD env (absolute ceiling, tighten-only).
_phase_comment: Operator 2026-07-08 (BotResearch run 20260708-0015): pivot from premium BUYER to defined-risk premium SELLER after the day-1 MARA long-put loss. Credit spreads only — sell the volatility risk premium with capped worst case. Previous phase was 'all' (operator 2026-07-03); flip back by changing this one key.

market_data._comment: Set OA_OPTIONS_DATA_PROVIDER=public to use the read-only Public.com sidecar for option chains/quotes while Alpaca remains the paper execution broker. Public credentials are environment-only; this JSON cannot enable the sidecar by itself.

conviction._comment: Below floor: pass, no trade. Scales linearly floor->max to size_min->size_max fraction of per-position cap.

llm._comment: Read by harness/proposer.py. OA_LLM_PROVIDER / OA_DEEPSEEK_MODEL env override these; DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is env-only. Operator 2026-09-01: moved off the Claude Code CLI (its login expired twice and each time the daily cycle failed closed) onto the DeepSeek API. v4-pro over v4-flash: one call a day, cost is irrelevant, judgment is not.

wheel._csp_dte_min_comment: Must stay comfortably ABOVE dte_close (21): the scoring formula favors the shortest DTE in range, so a dte_min equal to dte_close would preferentially open positions the exit sweep force-closes the same day (guaranteed round-trip spread loss).

spreads._comment: RESEARCH.md: short strike 15-30 delta, 30-45 DTE, 50% profit / 21 DTE exit (best-verified rule in the research). A hard historical-winner overfit profile in harness/risk_rails.py currently admits only CCL bullish put, SOFI bullish put, and F bearish call profiles; it is documentation-only here and cannot be broadened by JSON edits.
spreads._width_comment: 2.0 since 2026-07-08 (was 5.0): GLM-skeptic survival condition on a $5k account — max loss per spread ~$200 minus credit (~4% of account) instead of ~$500 (~10%), so one overnight gap through several spreads stays survivable.
spreads._stop_comment: Close at 2x credit only after 10:00 ET and only after two consecutive 20-minute sweeps confirm the breach. This prevents one wide opening quote from repeating the July 10 VZ liquidation while retaining a real loss control.

long_options._comment: RESEARCH.md: no firm entry convention (thesis-driven); delta band 0.50-0.70 scaled by conviction, 30-45 DTE for theta runway. Exit = E*TRADE convention: +100% profit / -50% stop, 21 DTE force close.
long_options._stop_comment: null = NO per-position stop (operator 2026-07-10, paper account, learn the full outcome distribution). Max loss on a long option is the debit paid, already bounded. Was 0.50. Inactive while phase = credit_spreads_only. Re-enable = set a float.

straddles._comment: RESEARCH.md: ATM both legs, ~45 DTE entry, close early (never hold to expiry). Long straddle exit as % of debit paid; covered straddle short legs follow the short-premium 50%/21DTE rules. Least-standardized strategies — these knobs are starting points.
straddles._long_stop_comment: null = NO per-position stop (operator 2026-07-10, paper account, learn the full outcome distribution). Long straddle max loss = debit paid, already bounded. Was 0.50. Inactive while phase = credit_spreads_only. Re-enable = set a float.

self_learning._comment: Deferred until a paper track record exists, per ARCHITECTURE.md.

scalp._comment: 0DTE Opening-Range-Breakout scalp mode. FULLY ISOLATED from the credit-spread seller above. Off unless OA_SCALP_ENABLED=true. Tunables only; the hard rails (ScalpRails) live in harness/risk_rails.py and env can only TIGHTEN them. Probe 2026-07-10 confirmed 0DTE SPY/QQQ listed + SIP entitled + snapshot has NO open-interest, so the liquidity guard is spread-only.
scalp._data_feed_comment: SIP verified on OptionsAgent's own keys (login-level entitlement). IEX fallback degrades the volume/RVOL surge signal.
scalp._range_comment: Do not trade the first N minutes; mark the 09:30-09:33 ET high/low as the opening range.
scalp._rvol_comment: Breakout bar volume must be >= rvol_min x the session's average 1-min volume so far (volume-surge confirmation).
scalp._per_trade_comment: Small fixed per-trade budget so a scalp can never starve the seller's spreads. Options BP is shared; probe showed only ~$1,579 available.
scalp._daily_loss_comment: 0 = DISABLED. NOTE: the effective daily-loss halt is the hard rail in harness/risk_rails.py (ScalpRails.daily_loss_stop_usd), which is what run_scalp.py enforces via active_scalp_rails(); this config key is documentation-only. Re-enable via OA_SCALP_DAILY_LOSS_USD env (positive $) or by setting the code default. The hard two-trade/day cap bounds the scalp budget to 2 * $250 = $500 before exits.
scalp._thesis_stop_comment: While the underlying remains outside the opening range and on the matching side of VWAP, suppress the normal 30% stop/time cut but retain this catastrophic premium-loss stop.
scalp._theta_comment: If the option hasn't hit target within N minutes, cut it only after the underlying also loses the opening-range/VWAP thesis.
scalp._spread_comment: Skip a 0DTE contract whose (ask-bid)/mid exceeds this (liquidity guard; OI is not exposed by Alpaca so spread is the only guard).
scalp._entry_cutoff_comment: Documentation mirror of the hard ScalpRails cutoff. Historical replay found 12/12 realized entries after 11:30 ET lost; no new entries at/after 11:30 ET. This is not a runtime override.
scalp._eod_flatten_comment: MANDATORY: force-close any open scalp by this ET time. An ITM 0DTE left to expiry auto-exercises into 100 shares (~$75k on SPY) on a $5k account. Non-negotiable.

equity_scalp._comment: Share-based intraday rules mined 2026-08-28 from 125 sessions (research_scalp_mine/stage3), deliberate in-sample overfit frozen for live out-of-sample collection. Hard caps live in harness/risk_rails.py EquityScalpRails; this section is documentation + tunables only. Rule A morning fade: SPY+QQQ at 10:15, fade a close beyond BOTH vwap and the 15m opening range (+$23.6/trade in-sample, 60% win, OOS positive). Rule C gap follow: QQQ at 13:00 with |gap|>0.8%, hold with the gap (+$34.3/trade, 64% win, OOS t=+3.1). Sizing $20k notional, stop 0.7%, 120m time exit, 15:50 flatten, -$300 daily halt.
